_orgwave.title: Confluence
_orgwave.purpose: Create and update Confluence pages (e.g. playbook confluence-service-doc).
env: CONFLUENCE_BASE_URL — Cloud: https://<site>.atlassian.net/wiki ; Server/Data Center: your Confluence base including /wiki if applicable.
CONFLUENCE_USER_EMAIL — Atlassian account email (API token is tied to this user).
Set all three in repo-root `.env` (envFile). Same file as GitHub PAT is fine.
